diarization.backend: native ECAPA FP32, request-local cosine average linkage
diarization.references: up to 4 inline audio data URLs, 2 to 10 seconds each
diarization.timing: actual aligner words assigned by acoustic interval overlap

overlap.quotas: one original RPM/output/VAD/window budget for both tracks

alignment.timestamps: actual fixed-model word edges; repaired ordering is explicit

chunking.failure: no partial success or dropped tail
chunking.offsets: real original sample origin; seek in 10ms feature frames

x-q4t.multipart_arrays: repeated bracket names; nested chunking_strategy bracket fields or JSON object
x-q4t.zero_temperature: native confidence policy; not a claim about private provider thresholds

limits: optional v2 fixed-window requests/tokens per minute

governance.enabled_by: v2 rates; v3 revisioned administration; v4 explicit file capacity; zero disables rates
governance.reservation: full prompt plus available output, retained across windows
governance.settlement: slot-admitted full prompt plus logical output, including failure/cancellation
governance.fair_queue: prepared-slot client round robin, per-client bounded queue share

gateway_client_policy.defaults: omitted/null output budget is min(server default, client output limit)
gateway_client_policy.local_admin: exact GET health/liveness/readiness/config/metrics remain trusted same-host routes; gateway denies them
